name: Yamata no Orochi
source:
The dragon god of the Winter Village.

He was once an evil god who took human sacrifices before he was defeated by the protagonist's ancestor.

[spoiler]Because the Sword of the Gathering Clouds of Heaven came from his tail, he absorbs the protagonist's life force whenever she uses the Sword.

Fuyukiku was chosen to be his medium, and can give the protagonist her stolen life force back.[/spoiler]
